The jig consists of a PTFE bottom alignment fixture with slotted access points which the bottom steel tab substrate is placed. PTFE was selected due to its inert nature and lack of interaction with the adhesive used. A PTFE top-plate is placed on top of the lap shear specimens to apply uniform pressure during curing and further constrain the AM-OM samples. Finally, each steel tab substrate is fixed in place individually with a corresponding 32 | P age positioning screw. This entire fixture is fastened on top of a bottom steel plate to preserve the flatness of the bottom alignment fixture. After curing, there is a set screw under each lap shear specimen to aid in the removal process. This jig was designed to be module and can allow different sample geometries which an exchange of a different bottom alignment fixture. All other components can be reserved. The jig design is shown in Figure 5.4.2. This fixture and fabrication process is an adaptation of multiple standards (ASTM d5868, ASTM D3163, and ASTM D1002) but rather than testing the adhesive properties, we are using the adhesive as a coupling-medium to transfer the shear forces into the AM-OM sample. This is a novel approach which has never been explored, to the best of the authors knowledge. Only the PTFE Alignment Fixture would need to be fabricated with a new geometry, while all other components can be reserved. 34 | P age Shear Specimens Fabrication An AM-OM sample dimension size of 54 mm x 60 mm was selected to achieve optimal lattice density. Therefore, the jig was fabricated to with a bottom alignment fixture corresponding to these dimensions, shown in Figure 5.4.3. A structural epoxy adhesive was selected (3M™ DP420) and combined with 1% by weight spherical glass beads with 240 μm diameter to control the bondline thickness. The general procedure for shear specimen fabrication includes (1) place bottom steel tab within the alignment fixture, clamp with positioning screw, (2) place AM-OM sample in correct orientation with uniform layer of adhesive on both sides, (4) top steel tab is placed on top, (5) the top plate is fastened down and applies a uniform pressure, and then (5) clamp top steel tab with positioning screw.
